Rayfield Chatgpt

Rayfield Chatgpt is an advanced Roblox exploit GUI designed to provide players with customizable in-game enhancements. Developed using the Rayfield UI library, this script is fully open-source and easy to use. The interface is intuitive and organized into multiple tabs, giving users streamlined control over their gameplay modifications.

Features

Movement Enhancements

Adjustable WalkSpeed and JumpPower sliders

Fly with smooth acceleration and configurable speed

Infinite Jump for unrestricted vertical mobility

Combat Utilities

Aimlock system with customizable keybind

FOV Circle visualizer centered on the mouse

Option to ignore teammates for more precise targeting

Visual & Fun Features

Spin toggle with adjustable rotation speed

Noclip toggle for seamless movement through obstacles

Teleportation Tools

Teleport to any player using username or display name input

Extras Tab

Placeholder for future enhancements and experimental features

Customizable toggles and input fields

Why Rayfield Chatgpt?

This script was intelligently designed to combine performance, reliability, and ease-of-use. All toggles, sliders, and inputs are dynamically responsive, ensuring that player settings persist across character respawns. Notifications provide real-time feedback for every action, improving user experience.
